always: Hero is a single 3D-rendered object shown from slightly above, at a mild high three-quarter angle: top face visible, one or two side faces turned toward camera, never a pure side elevation (palm, pump, booth and carousel come closest).
Perspective is mild and consistent within an object: edges converge gently (phone booth, planter, pump, book), with no fisheye or wide-angle stretching.
Hero and ground plane agree: where a floor is present, normals show a flat green-cyan plane with a horizon band behind it, and the hero base sits on it with a contact shadow or footprint.
Rounded hero forms read as smooth swollen normal gradients (pillow, gloves, fins, shoes); hard-edged forms read as even flat patches with crisp edges (booth, planter, ticket, book cover).
Depth is shallow and layered in simple tiers: hero, a ground or table, then a simple backdrop. The hero is always the nearest and largest object.
varies: Camera height: top-down or near top-down for flat items (ticket, pillow, fins, book on table) versus a low eye-level three-quarter for tall items (phone booth, carousel, pump, palm, planter).

Ground presence: no ground, only an abstract flat backdrop with stripes or rings (ticket, pillow, fins); a floor with a horizon line (booth, carousel, shoes, gloves, palm, pump); a tabletop that fills the frame (book).

Background treatment: flat graphic color or pattern (most cards), a simple painted scene (fence, desert mesas, sky), or a fully built environment with mid-ground props (the pool bar, which has foreground and background layers and a cropped roof).
Number of layers: one (ticket) up to four or five (pool bar: roof, bar, stools, water, pool edge).
Crop: some heroes sit fully inside the frame with margin; the gloves and the pool bar crop at the edges.
Planar share: very high on the ticket (almost fully flat normals), moderate on the booth, planter and book, low on the pillow, gloves and fins.
never: Strong wide-angle distortion or forced extreme perspective.
A true bird's-eye view that makes a standing object look flat, or a worm's-eye view from below.
Heavy depth-of-field blur: backgrounds are simplified or flat, not optically blurred (a faint softening in the desert and fence scenes is the most there is).
A hero floating without any relation to its ground when a floor is shown.
Parts of one object drawn from different viewpoints, except the flat ticket, which is a graphic.
Several competing focal depths: the hero stays nearest and sharpest.
generator_wording: Single hero object in soft 3D render, seen from slightly above in a mild three-quarter view with gentle perspective, no wide-angle distortion. Hero stands on a simple ground plane with a soft contact shadow, in front of a flat or simplified backdrop. Rounded forms are smooth and swollen, hard forms have flat faces. Background is simpler, not blurred.
